mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget AS budget, c.company_name AS companyName, u.name AS clientName, DATEDIFF(p.deadline_date, CURDATE()) AS dday, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_bookmarks pb WHERE pb.project_id = p.project_id AND pb.user_id = #{userId} ) END AS bookmarked FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.project_status = 'READY'
ORDER BY
p.budget DESC, p.created_at DESC p.deadline_date ASC, p.project_id DESC p.created_at DESC, p.project_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE AND p.project_status = 'READY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE project_status = 'READY' /* 모집 중인 건만 집계 (모집 종료된 건은 집계 제외) */ AND deadline_date >= CURDATE() AND deadline_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 8 DAY)

SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.client_id AS clientId, p.title AS title, p.description AS description, p.start_date AS startDate, p.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.budget AS budget, p.communicate_method AS communicateMethod, p.payment_method AS paymentMethod, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget_negotiable AS budgetNegotiable, p.duration_negotiable AS durationNegotiable, p.plan_url AS planUrl, u.name AS clientName, c.company_name AS companyName, cp.client_type AS clientType, c.industry AS companyIndustry
FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_applications (project_id, freelancer_id, is_contracted, applied_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, false, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_applications WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND freelancer_id = #{userId}
